tools.name: invest_create_favorite_group
tools.description: Create a named group for organising favorite instruments. Returns the ID of the newly created group, which can be used with invest_delete_favorite_group and other favorite group operations.

groupColor.description: Group colour in HEX format, e.g. 'FF5733'. Range: 000000–FFFFFF.

note.description: Optional free-text description of the group.

groupId.description: Unique identifier of the created group

tools.name: invest_delete_favorite_group
tools.description: Delete a favorite instrument group by its ID. This operation is irreversible. Obtain the group ID from invest_create_favorite_group or favorite_groups_list.

groupId.description: ID of the favorite group to delete.

outputSchema.description: Empty object returned on success. Deletion is confirmed by the absence of an error.

tools.name: invest_edit_favorite_instruments
tools.description: Add or remove instruments from the authenticated user's favorites list. Returns the updated list of favorite instruments for the specified group after the operation. Use ADD to add instruments and DEL to remove them. Obtain instrument UIDs from invest_find_instrument or other instrument lookup tools.

actionType.description: Action to perform on the favorites list. ADD — add instruments to the list. DEL — remove instruments from the list.

groupId.description: Favorite group ID. Obtain from invest_create_favorite_group.

favoriteInstruments.description: Updated list of favorite instruments in the group

tools.name: invest_find_instrument
tools.description: Search for financial instruments by a free-text query string. Returns a list of matching instruments with their identifiers and metadata. Use instrumentKind to narrow results to a specific asset class (e.g. INSTRUMENT_TYPE_SHARE for stocks). Set apiTradeAvailableFlag to true to return only instruments tradeable via API. Use responseView to control which fields are included in the response.

apiTradeAvailableFlag.description: When true, return only instruments tradeable via the API.

instrumentKind.description: Filter results by instrument type. Omit or use INSTRUMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED to search across all types.

query.description: Free-text search string (instrument name, ticker, ISIN, etc.).

responseView.description: BASE (name, uid) always included. Add: IDENTIFIERS=ticker/classCode/isin/positionUid, STATIC_DATA=lot/instrumentKind, TRADING_FLAGS=API/IIS/qualifiedInvestor flags, MARKET_DATA=first candle dates. Use FULL for all.

instruments.description: List of instruments matching the search query

apiTradeAvailableFlag.description: Whether trading via API is available

first1dayCandleDate.description: Date of the first 1-day candle (ISO 8601 UTC)

first1minCandleDate.description: Date of the first 1-minute candle (ISO 8601 UTC)

forIisFlag.description: Whether the instrument can be bought/sold in an IIS account

forQualInvestorFlag.description: Whether trading is restricted to qualified investors only

tools.name: invest_get_asset
tools.description: Get an asset by its identifier. An asset is a higher-level entity that groups related instruments (e.g. a company or index). Returns the asset's name, type, brand information, and the list of associated instrument UIDs.

tools.name: invest_get_asset_fundamentals
tools.description: Get fundamental financial indicators for one or more assets. Returns market cap, valuation ratios (P/E, P/B, P/S, EV/EBITDA), profitability metrics (ROE, ROA, ROIC, net margin), revenue and EPS growth rates, debt ratios, and dividend data. Use for fundamental analysis before taking a position.

assets.description: Asset UIDs to query (up to 100). Each element is a plain UID string, not an object.

items.description: Asset identifier (UID) as a plain string.

averageDailyVolumeLast10Days.description: Average daily trading volume over the last 10 days

averageDailyVolumeLast4Weeks.description: Average daily trading volume over the last 4 weeks

beta.description: Beta — volatility relative to the overall market

currentRatioMrq.description: Current ratio — current assets / current liabilities

dilutedEpsTtm.description: Diluted EPS assuming all convertible securities are converted

dividendPayoutRatioFy.description: Dividend payout ratio — net income paid out as dividends

dividendRateTtm.description: Dividends paid over the last 12 months

dividendYieldDailyTtm.description: Dividend yield over the last 12 months

exDividendDate.description: Ex-dividend date — last day to buy for dividend eligibility

fixedChargeCoverageRatioFy.description: Fixed charge coverage ratio (FCCR) — earnings / fixed charges

forwardAnnualDividendYield.description: Forward annual dividend yield as a percentage of share price

freeCashFlowToPrice.description: Free cash flow to price ratio

netMarginMrq.description: Net profit margin — net income as a percentage of revenue

peRatioTtm.description: P/E ratio — market cap / net income

priceToBookTtm.description: P/B ratio — market cap / book value

priceToFreeCashFlowTtm.description: P/FCF ratio — market cap / free cash flow

roa.description: Return on assets — net income as a percentage of total assets

roe.description: Return on equity — net income as a percentage of shareholders' equity

totalDebtMrq.description: Total debt — sum of short-term and long-term liabilities

totalEnterpriseValueMrq.description: Enterprise value (EV) — includes debt and non-operating assets

tools.name: invest_get_bond_accrued
tools.description: Get accrued coupon interest (ACI) for a bond over a date range. Returns daily NKD values, percentage values, and nominal amounts. Useful for calculating the full price of a bond purchase including accrued interest.

from.description: Start of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

to.description: End of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

accruedInterests.description: Accrued coupon interest entries for the requested period

nominal.description: Bond nominal value on the date

valuePercent.description: ACI as a percentage of nominal on the date

tools.name: invest_get_bond_events
tools.description: Get the schedule of events for a bond (coupons, call options/offers, redemptions, conversions) over a date range. Use type to filter by a specific event type. Use responseView to control how much detail is returned per event.

from.description: Start of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

responseView.description: BASE (eventDate, eventType) always included. Add: EVENT_INFO=event DETAILS (number/DATES/payment/execution), COUPON_INFO=coupon DATES/period/rate. Use FULL for all.

to.description: End of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

type.description: Filter by event type. EVENT_TYPE_CPN — coupon payment. EVENT_TYPE_CALL — call option / offer. EVENT_TYPE_MTY — redemption at maturity. EVENT_TYPE_CONV — conversion.

execution.description: Execution status. E — paid on time; D — default; T — technical default; TD — technical default; ED — paid after default; ET — technical default obligations fulfilled; ES — obligations fulfilled by agreement; S — agreement.

fixDate.description: Record date for participation in the event

rateDate.description: Date on which the event rate or fact is determined

tools.name: invest_get_brand
tools.description: Get a brand by its identifier. Returns the brand's name, sector, company, country, and descriptive information. Brand UIDs are available in the asset response from invest_get_asset.

tools.name: invest_get_dfa
tools.description: Get a DFA (Digital Financial Asset / smart-asset) by its identifier. Returns details about the instrument including its maturity date, coupon structure, basic assets composition, and trading flags. Use idType to specify the type of identifier: UID is preferred for uniqueness.

idType.description: Type of the identifier supplied in 'instrumentId'. UID is preferred (globally unique).

instrumentId.description: Instrument identifier. Value format depends on idType.

responseView.description: BASE (name, uid) always included. Add: IDENTIFIERS=ticker/positionUid, STATIC_DATA=maturity/currency/nominal/lot/type, ADDITIONAL_INFO=coupon value and basicAssets, TRADING_FLAGS=order types and access flags, MARKET_DATA=prices/ACI/yield. Use FULL for all.

aciValue.description: Accrued coupon income (ACI) value at current date

apiTradeAvailableFlag.description: Whether trading via API is available

basicAssets.description: Basic assets included in the DFA

bestpriceOrderAvailableFlag.description: Whether bestprice orders can be placed for this instrument

couponPaymentFrequency.description: Number of coupon payments per year

forIisFlag.description: Whether the instrument can be bought/sold in an IIS account

forQualInvestorFlag.description: Whether trading is restricted to qualified investors only

limitOrderAvailableFlag.description: Whether limit orders can be placed for this instrument

marketOrderAvailableFlag.description: Whether market orders can be placed for this instrument

type.description: Asset type: credit_portfolio_dfa (credit portfolio token) or debt_dfa (debt token)

tools.name: invest_get_favorite_groups
tools.description: Get the list of favorite instrument groups for the authenticated user. Optionally filter by a list of instruments to see which groups contain them, and exclude specific groups from the response by their ID.

excludedGroupId.description: Group IDs to exclude from the response.

instruments.description: Instruments to filter groups by. When provided, containsInstrument flag in each group indicates whether the group contains at least one of these instruments.

containsInstrument.description: Whether the group contains at least one of the requested instruments

size.description: Number of instruments in the group

tools.name: invest_get_favorite_instruments
tools.description: Get the list of favorite instruments for the authenticated user. Optionally filter by group ID to retrieve favorites within a specific group. Obtain group IDs from invest_get_favorite_groups or invest_create_favorite_group.

groupId.description: Favorite group ID. When provided, returns only instruments in this group.

tools.name: invest_get_forecast
tools.description: Get analyst forecasts for an instrument by its UID. Returns individual price targets from investment houses and a consensus summary (average/min/max target price, overall recommendation, and price-change delta). Use responseView to include individual targets alongside the consensus.

responseView.description: BASE (consensus with ticker) always included. Add TARGETS for individual investment-house forecasts. Use FULL for all.

consensus.description: Consensus forecast aggregated across all active price targets
Average target price across all active forecasts

maxTarget.description: Maximum target price among active forecasts

minTarget.description: Minimum target price among active forecasts

priceChange.description: Difference between consensus target and current price

priceChangeRel.description: Percentage difference between consensus target and current price

company.description: Investment house that issued the forecast

priceChange.description: Absolute price change from current to target

priceChangeRel.description: Relative price change from current to target, %

recommendationDate.description: Date and time the forecast was issued (ISO 8601 UTC)

tools.name: invest_get_insider_deals
tools.description: Get insider trading transactions for an instrument. Returns trades by company insiders (executives, board members, major shareholders), including direction, price, quantity, and the relationship of the trader to the issuer. Supports cursor-based pagination; use nextCursor from the response for subsequent pages.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass nextCursor from the previous response to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Must not exceed 100.

direction.description: Transaction direction. TRADE_DIRECTION_BUY — purchase; TRADE_DIRECTION_SELL — sale; TRADE_DIRECTION_INCREASE — increase in stake; TRADE_DIRECTION_DECREASE — decrease in stake.

disclosureDate.description: Date the transaction was publicly disclosed (ISO 8601 UTC)

investorName.description: Name of the individual or company that executed the transaction

investorPosition.description: Relationship of the trader to the issuer (e.g. CEO, board member)

isOptionExecution.description: Whether the transaction is an option exercise

percentage.description: Volume bought/sold as a percentage of total securities outstanding

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page of results. Absent when there are no more records.

tools.name: invest_get_instrument_reports
tools.description: Get scheduled financial report publication events for an instrument over a date range. Returns report dates, fiscal period year and number, report type (quarterly, semi-annual, annual), and record creation timestamp. Use to track upcoming earnings releases.

from.description: Start of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

to.description: End of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

periodNum.description: Period number within the year. 1 — full year / H1 / Q1; 2 — H2 / Q2; 3 — Q3; 4 — Q4.

periodType.description: Report period type. PERIOD_TYPE_QUARTER — quarterly. PERIOD_TYPE_SEMIANNUAL — semi-annual. PERIOD_TYPE_ANNUAL — annual.

periodYear.description: Fiscal year of the report period

tools.name: invest_get_risk_rates
tools.description: Get risk rates for a list of instruments. Returns long and short margin risk rates per risk-level category for each instrument. Use to evaluate margin requirements before opening leveraged positions.

instrumentId.description: Instrument identifiers to query risk rates for (UID or ticker_classCode).

tools.name: invest_get_share_dividends
tools.description: Get the list of dividend payments for a share over a date range. Returns dividend amount per share, payment date, last buy date (to qualify for dividend), record date, yield, and the closing price on the last buy date.

from.description: Start of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

instrumentId.description: Instrument identifier. Pass it as ticker_classCode.

to.description: End of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

lastBuyDate.description: Last day (inclusive) to buy the share and qualify for this dividend

tools.name: invest_get_trading_schedule
tools.description: Get trading schedule for one or all exchanges for the requested date range. Returns trading and non-trading days with intervals (pre-market, main session, etc.). Omit exchange to retrieve schedules for all exchanges at once.

exchange.description: Exchange name. Omit to get schedules for all exchanges.

from.description: Start of the requested period in ISO 8601 UTC format. Cannot be earlier than the current date — this is an upcoming trading schedule, not a historical calendar. The from–to period must not exceed 14 days. If you don't know today's date, omit from/to entirely to get the schedule for the next few upcoming days.

to.description: End of the requested period in ISO 8601 UTC format. Cannot be earlier than the current date, and must be at most 14 days after from. Omit from/to to get the schedule for the upcoming days.

days.description: Trading and non-trading days in the requested period

interval.description: Start and end timestamps of the interval

endTs.description: Interval end time in ISO 8601 UTC

startTs.description: Interval start time in ISO 8601 UTC

isTradingDay.description: Whether this is a trading day on the exchange

tools.name: invest_list_assets
tools.description: Get the list of assets filtered by instrument status and type. An asset is a higher-level entity that groups related instruments (e.g. a company or index). Use instrumentType to narrow results to a specific asset class.

instrumentStatus.description: Filter by instrument availability. INSTRUMENT_STATUS_BASE — only instruments tradeable via API. INSTRUMENT_STATUS_ALL — full catalogue including non-tradeable instruments.

instrumentType.description: Filter by instrument type. Omit or use INSTRUMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED to return assets of all types.

tools.name: invest_list_bonds
tools.description: Get the full list of bonds available on Tinkoff Invest. Use instrumentStatus to filter by availability: INSTRUMENT_STATUS_BASE returns only instruments currently tradeable via API, INSTRUMENT_STATUS_ALL returns the complete catalogue including non-tradeable instruments. Use responseView to limit returned fields. Optionally use filter parameters to keep only matching instruments in the response.

callDateFrom.description: Filter by call/offer date on/after this date (ISO 8601).

callDateTo.description: Filter by call/offer date on/before this date (ISO 8601).

couponQuantityPerYear.description: Filter by number of coupon payments per year.

currency.description: Filter by settlement currency, e.g. rub, usd.

instrumentStatus.description: Filter by instrument availability. INSTRUMENT_STATUS_BASE — only instruments tradeable via API (default). INSTRUMENT_STATUS_ALL — full catalogue including non-tradeable instruments.

maturityDateFrom.description: Filter by maturity date on/after this date (ISO 8601).

maturityDateTo.description: Filter by maturity date on/before this date (ISO 8601).

nominalFrom.description: Filter by nominal value >= this value, e.g. 1000.

nominalTo.description: Filter by nominal value <= this value, e.g. 5000.

responseView.description: BASE (name, uid) always included. Add: IDENTIFIERS=exchange codes (ticker/classCode/isin), STATIC_DATA=maturity/nominal/lot, ADDITIONAL_INFO=coupon structure and amortization flags, TRADING_FLAGS=trading restrictions, MARKET_DATA=exchange/prices/candle dates. Use FULL for all.

aciValue.description: Accrued coupon income (ACI) value at current date

amortizationFlag.description: Whether the bond has principal amortisation

apiTradeAvailableFlag.description: Whether trading via API is available

couponQuantityPerYear.description: Number of coupon payments per year

first1dayCandleDate.description: Date of the first 1-day candle (ISO 8601 UTC)

first1minCandleDate.description: Date of the first 1-minute candle (ISO 8601 UTC)

floatingCouponFlag.description: Whether the bond has a floating coupon rate

forIisFlag.description: Whether the instrument can be bought/sold in an IIS account

forQualInvestorFlag.description: Whether trading is restricted to qualified investors only

initialNominal.description: Original nominal value of the bond

perpetualFlag.description: Whether the bond is perpetual (no maturity)

requiredTests.description: Tests the client must pass before purchasing this instrument

tools.name: invest_list_brands
tools.description: Get a paginated list of all brands available on Tinkoff Invest. Use paging.limit and paging.pageNumber to page through large result sets. The response includes a paging object with totalCount for calculating total pages.

limit.description: Maximum number of brands to return per page.
Page size used in the request

tools.name: invest_list_consensus_forecasts
tools.description: Get a paginated list of analyst consensus forecasts for instruments. Returns 12-month target prices (low/high/best), buy/hold/sell recommendation counts, overall consensus recommendation, and prognosis date. Use paging to iterate through large result sets.

limit.description: Maximum number of forecasts to return per page.
Page size used in the request

tools.name: invest_list_countries
tools.description: Get the reference list of all countries with their ISO alpha-2 and alpha-3 codes.

tools.name: invest_list_currencies
tools.description: Get the full list of currency instruments available on Tinkoff Invest. Use instrumentStatus to filter by availability: INSTRUMENT_STATUS_BASE returns only instruments currently tradeable via API, INSTRUMENT_STATUS_ALL returns the complete catalogue including non-tradeable instruments. The response may be large — use responseView to limit returned fields.

instrumentStatus.description: Filter by instrument availability. INSTRUMENT_STATUS_BASE — only instruments tradeable via API (default). INSTRUMENT_STATUS_ALL — full catalogue including non-tradeable instruments.

responseView.description: BASE (name, uid) always included. Add: IDENTIFIERS=exchange codes (ticker/classCode/isin), STATIC_DATA=currency/nominal/lot, TRADING_FLAGS=trading restrictions, MARKET_DATA=exchange/prices/candle dates. Use FULL for all.

apiTradeAvailableFlag.description: Whether trading via API is available

first1dayCandleDate.description: Date of the first 1-day candle (ISO 8601 UTC)

first1minCandleDate.description: Date of the first 1-minute candle (ISO 8601 UTC)

forIisFlag.description: Whether the instrument can be bought/sold in an IIS account

forQualInvestorFlag.description: Whether trading is restricted to qualified investors only

requiredTests.description: Tests the client must pass before purchasing this instrument

tools.description: Get the full list of DFA (Digital Financial Assets / smart-assets) available on Tinkoff Invest. Returns details about each instrument including its maturity date, coupon structure, basic assets composition, and trading flags. Use responseView to limit returned fields. Optionally use filter parameters to keep only matching instruments in the response.

couponPaymentFrequency.description: Filter by number of coupon payments per year.

couponValueFrom.description: Filter by coupon value >= this value, e.g. 100.

couponValueTo.description: Filter by coupon value <= this value, e.g. 500.

currency.description: Filter by settlement currency, e.g. rub, usd.

maturityDateFrom.description: Filter by maturity date on/after this date (ISO 8601).

maturityDateTo.description: Filter by maturity date on/before this date (ISO 8601).

nominalFrom.description: Filter by nominal value >= this value, e.g. 1000.

nominalTo.description: Filter by nominal value <= this value, e.g. 5000.

responseView.description: BASE (name, uid) always included. Add: IDENTIFIERS=ticker/positionUid, STATIC_DATA=maturity/currency/nominal/lot/type, ADDITIONAL_INFO=coupon value and basicAssets, TRADING_FLAGS=order types and access flags, MARKET_DATA=prices/ACI/yield. Use FULL for all.

aciValue.description: Accrued coupon income (ACI) value at current date

apiTradeAvailableFlag.description: Whether trading via API is available

basicAssets.description: Basic assets included in the DFA

bestpriceOrderAvailableFlag.description: Whether bestprice orders can be placed for this instrument

couponPaymentFrequency.description: Number of coupon payments per year

forIisFlag.description: Whether the instrument can be bought/sold in an IIS account

forQualInvestorFlag.description: Whether trading is restricted to qualified investors only

limitOrderAvailableFlag.description: Whether limit orders can be placed for this instrument

marketOrderAvailableFlag.description: Whether market orders can be placed for this instrument

type.description: Asset type: credit_portfolio_dfa (credit portfolio token) or debt_dfa (debt token)

tools.name: invest_list_etfs
tools.description: Get the full list of ETFs (exchange-traded funds) available on Tinkoff Invest. Use instrumentStatus to filter by availability: INSTRUMENT_STATUS_BASE returns only instruments currently tradeable via API, INSTRUMENT_STATUS_ALL returns the complete catalogue including non-tradeable instruments. The response may be large — use responseView to limit returned fields.

instrumentStatus.description: Filter by instrument availability. INSTRUMENT_STATUS_BASE — only instruments tradeable via API (default). INSTRUMENT_STATUS_ALL — full catalogue including non-tradeable instruments.

apiTradeAvailableFlag.description: Whether trading via API is available

first1dayCandleDate.description: Date of the first 1-day candle (ISO 8601 UTC)

first1minCandleDate.description: Date of the first 1-minute candle (ISO 8601 UTC)

forIisFlag.description: Whether the instrument can be bought/sold in an IIS account

forQualInvestorFlag.description: Whether trading is restricted to qualified investors only

requiredTests.description: Tests the client must pass before purchasing this instrument

tools.name: invest_list_futures
tools.description: Get the full list of futures contracts available on Tinkoff Invest. Use instrumentStatus to filter by availability: INSTRUMENT_STATUS_BASE returns only instruments currently tradeable via API, INSTRUMENT_STATUS_ALL returns the complete catalogue including non-tradeable instruments. Use responseView to limit returned fields. Optionally use filter parameters to keep only matching instruments in the response.

basicAsset.description: Filter by underlying asset name (exact match).

currency.description: Filter by settlement currency, e.g. rub, usd.

expirationDateFrom.description: Filter by expiration date on/after this date (ISO 8601).

expirationDateTo.description: Filter by expiration date on/before this date (ISO 8601).

instrumentStatus.description: Filter by instrument availability. INSTRUMENT_STATUS_BASE — only instruments tradeable via API (default). INSTRUMENT_STATUS_ALL — full catalogue including non-tradeable instruments.

responseView.description: BASE (name, uid) always included. apiTradeAvailableFlag.description: Whether trading via API is available

basicAssetPositionUid.description: Unique position identifier of the underlying instrument

first1dayCandleDate.description: Date of the first 1-day candle (ISO 8601 UTC)

first1minCandleDate.description: Date of the first 1-minute candle (ISO 8601 UTC)

forIisFlag.description: Whether the instrument can be bought/sold in an IIS account

forQualInvestorFlag.description: Whether trading is restricted to qualified investors only

futuresType.description: Futures settlement type. DELIVERY_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DELIVERY — physical delivery of the underlying. DELIVERY_TYPE_CASH_SETTLEMENT — cash settlement.

minPriceIncrementAmount.description: Monetary value of one price increment step

requiredTests.description: Tests the client must pass before purchasing this instrument

tools.name: invest_list_indicatives
tools.description: Get the list of indicative instruments: indices, commodities, and other reference instruments. These are non-tradeable price reference instruments such as market indices (e.g. IMOEX) and commodity benchmarks. Optionally include index composition data via responseView.

responseView.description: BASE (name, ticker, classCode, currency) always included. Add INDEX_COMPOSITION for constituent instruments and their weights. Use FULL for all.

uid.description: Unique instrument identifier of the constituent

weight.description: Weight of the constituent in the index, %

tools.name: invest_list_options
tools.description: Get the list of option contracts for a given underlying asset. Filter by basic instrument ID (preferred — pass ticker_classCode directly, e.g. SBER_TQBR), asset UID, or position UID. Use responseView to control the response size. Optionally use filter parameters to keep only matching instruments in the response.

basicAssetPositionUid.description: Underlying asset position UID. Use only if you don't have a ticker_classCode for the underlying instrument — prefer basicInstrumentId otherwise. Provide exactly one of basicInstrumentId/basicAssetUid/basicAssetPositionUid — omitting all three returns an error.

basicAssetUid.description: Underlying asset UID. Use only if you don't have a ticker_classCode for the underlying instrument — prefer basicInstrumentId otherwise. Provide exactly one of basicInstrumentId/basicAssetUid/basicAssetPositionUid — omitting all three returns an error.

basicInstrumentId.description: Preferred way to identify the underlying instrument: ticker_classCode (e.g. SBER_TQBR). Provide exactly one of basicInstrumentId/basicAssetUid/basicAssetPositionUid — omitting all three returns an error.

currency.description: Filter by settlement currency, e.g. rub, usd.

expirationDateFrom.description: Filter by expiration date on/after this date (ISO 8601).

expirationDateTo.description: Filter by expiration date on/before this date (ISO 8601).

responseView.description: BASE (name, uid) always included. Add: IDENTIFIERS=ticker/classCode/basicAssetPositionUid, STATIC_DATA=basicAsset/strikePrice/expiration/currency/lot/size, ADDITIONAL_INFO=direction/paymentType/style/settlementType/assetType, TRADING_FLAGS=trading restrictions, MARKET_DATA=exchange/prices/candle and trade DATES. Use FULL for all.

strikePriceFrom.description: Filter by strike price >= this value, e.g. 100.5.

strikePriceTo.description: Filter by strike price <= this value, e.g. 250.

apiTradeAvailableFlag.description: Whether trading via API is available

basicAssetPositionUid.description: Unique position identifier of the underlying asset

direction.description: Option direction: OPTION_DIRECTION_PUT — put; OPTION_DIRECTION_CALL — call.

first1dayCandleDate.description: Date of the first 1-day candle (ISO 8601 UTC)

first1minCandleDate.description: Date of the first 1-minute candle (ISO 8601 UTC)

forIisFlag.description: Whether the instrument can be bought/sold in an IIS account

forQualInvestorFlag.description: Whether trading is restricted to qualified investors only

paymentType.description: Margin type. OPTION_PAYMENT_TYPE_PREMIUM — premium option; OPTION_PAYMENT_TYPE_MARGINAL — margined option.

requiredTests.description: Tests the client must pass before purchasing this instrument

settlementType.description: Settlement type. OPTION_EXECUTION_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DELIVERY — physical delivery; OPTION_EXECUTION_TYPE_CASH_SETTLEMENT — cash settlement.

style.description: Exercise style. OPTION_STYLE_AMERICAN — can be exercised at any time before expiry; OPTION_STYLE_EUROPEAN — can only be exercised at expiry.

tools.name: invest_list_shares

instrumentStatus.description: Filter by instrument availability. INSTRUMENT_STATUS_BASE — only instruments tradeable via API (default). INSTRUMENT_STATUS_ALL — full catalogue including non-tradeable instruments.

forQualInvestorFlag.description: Whether trading is restricted to qualified investors only

requiredTests.description: Tests the client must pass before purchasing this instrument

currency.description: Filter by settlement currency, e.g. rub, usd.

instrumentStatus.description: Filter by instrument availability. INSTRUMENT_STATUS_BASE — only instruments tradeable via API (default). INSTRUMENT_STATUS_ALL — full catalogue including non-tradeable instruments.

maturityDateFrom.description: Filter by maturity date on/after this date (ISO 8601).

maturityDateTo.description: Filter by maturity date on/before this date (ISO 8601).

responseView.description: BASE (name, uid) always included. Add: IDENTIFIERS=exchange codes (ticker/classCode/isin), STATIC_DATA=assetType/currency/nominal/lot/maturityDate, TRADING_FLAGS=trading restrictions, MARKET_DATA=exchange/minPriceIncrement. Use FULL for all.

apiTradeAvailableFlag.description: Whether trading via API is available

basicAssets.description: Underlying assets included in the note

forIisFlag.description: Whether the instrument can be bought/sold in an IIS account

requiredTests.description: Tests the client must pass before purchasing this instrument

tools.name: invest_get_last_trades
tools.description: Get the last anonymous trades for an instrument over the past hour. Use instrumentId to specify the instrument, from/to to narrow the time range (ISO 8601 UTC), and tradeSource to filter by data source. Always read priceCurrency in the response to determine the actual currency (it may be "pt" for exchange points).

from.description: Start of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

to.description: End of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

tradeSource.description: Trade source filter. Default is TRADE_SOURCE_ALL. TRADE_SOURCE_EXCHANGE — exchange trades only. TRADE_SOURCE_DEALER — dealer trades only. TRADE_SOURCE_ALL — all trades.

priceCurrency.description: Currency of the price values, e.g. rub, usd. Can also be pt for futures and bonds, meaning the prices are exchange points.

quantity.description: Number of lots in the trade

tools.name: invest_get_market_values
tools.description: Get market data values for a list of instruments. Use instrumentId to specify instruments and values to select which value types to return (all types are returned if values is omitted). Always read priceCurrency in the response to determine the actual currency (it may be "pt" for exchange points).

instrumentId.description: Array of instrument identifiers (UID or ticker_classCode).

values.description: Value types to request. All types are returned if omitted. LAST_PRICE — last exchange price. LAST_PRICE_DEALER — last dealer price. CLOSE_PRICE — close price. EVENING_SESSION_PRICE — last evening session price. OPEN_INTEREST — open interest (futures only). THEOR_PRICE — theoretical price (options only). YIELD — yield.

instruments.description: Array of instruments with their market values

priceCurrency.description: Currency of the price values, e.g. rub, usd. Can also be pt for futures and bonds, meaning the prices are exchange points.

values.description: Array of market value entries for the instrument

tools.name: invest_get_orderbook
tools.description: Get the order book (market depth) for an instrument. Use depth to control how many price levels to return (1–50). Always read priceCurrency in the response to determine the actual currency (it may be "pt" for exchange points).

orderbookTs.description: Timestamp when the order book was formed on the exchange (UTC)

priceCurrency.description: Currency of the price values, e.g. rub, usd. Can also be pt for futures and bonds, meaning the prices are exchange points.

tools.name: invest_get_tech_analysis
tools.description: Get technical indicator values for an instrument over a time range. Supports BB (Bollinger Bands), EMA, RSI, MACD, and SMA. Use deviation for BB band width and smoothing for MACD periods. IMPORTANT: for futures and bonds indicator values are in exchange points, NOT a currency amount — do not label them as dollars, rubles, or any other currency.

deviation.description: Deviation parameters. Required for BB (together with length).

deviationMultiplier.description: Number of standard deviations for upper/lower bands (>0 and <=50).

from.description: Start of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

indicatorType.description: Technical indicator type. BB — Bollinger Bands. EMA — Exponential Moving Average. RSI — Relative Strength Index. MACD — Moving Average Convergence/Divergence. SMA — Simple Moving Average.

interval.description: Candle interval used for indicator calculation.

length.description: Indicator period (>=1 and <=1000). Required for RSI and BB (for BB, together with deviation).

to.description: End of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

typeOfPrice.description: Price type used for indicator calculation.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp for which the indicator values were calculated

tools.name: invest_get_trading_statuses
tools.description: Get current trading statuses for a list of instruments. Returns the exchange trading session state (normal trading, auction, break, etc.) and which order types (limit, market, bestprice) are accepted for each instrument. Use before placing an order to confirm that trading is currently available.

instrumentId.description: Array of instrument identifiers (UID or ticker_classCode).

tools.name: invest_get_blocked_guarantee
tools.description: Get currency positions blocked as futures guarantee collateral for a brokerage account.

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_broker_accounts.

blockedGuarantee.description: Array of currency positions blocked as futures guarantee collateral

tools.name: invest_get_operations
tools.description: Get a paginated list of operations for a brokerage account. Use accountId to specify the account, from/to for the time range (ISO 8601 UTC), cursor for pagination, and operationTypes/state to filter results. Use responseView to limit returned fields.

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_broker_accounts.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass nextCursor from the previous response to fetch the next page.

from.description: Start of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

limit.description: Maximum number of operations to return. Default is 100, maximum is 1000.

operationTypes.description: Array of operation types to filter by.

responseView.description: BASE (hasNext, nextCursor, items cursor/id/date/type/ticker/classCode/price/quantityDone/state) always included. Add: ADDITIONAL_INFO=quantity/parentOperationId/cancelDateTime/cancelReason, PAYMENTS=payment/accruedInt/commission/yield/yieldRelative, CHILD_OPERATIONS=child op DETAILS, TRADES=tradesInfo.TRADES DETAILS. Use FULL for all. Default: BASE.

to.description: End of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

hasNext.description: Whether there are more items to fetch

tools.name: invest_get_portfolio
tools.description: Get the portfolio for a brokerage account. Returns total portfolio value, yield metrics, and per-position details. Use responseView to limit returned fields.

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_broker_accounts.

responseView.description: BASE (totalAmountPortfolio, expectedYield, dailyYieldRelative, dailyYield) always included. Add: BY_INSTRUMENT_TYPE=total amounts by asset type, DETAILED=per-position DETAILS. Use FULL for all. Default: BASE.

averagePositionPriceFifo.description: Average lot price by FIFO method

blockedLots.description: Number of securities blocked by open orders

expectedYieldFifo.description: Current calculated yield by FIFO method

quantity.description: Number of securities in the portfolio

varMarginSettled.description: Variation margin from settlement price or closing price

totalAmountBonds.description: Total value of bonds in the portfolio

totalAmountCurrencies.description: Total value of currencies in the portfolio

totalAmountDfa.description: Total value of smart assets (DFA) in the portfolio

totalAmountEtf.description: Total value of ETFs in the portfolio

totalAmountFutures.description: Total value of futures in the portfolio

totalAmountOptions.description: Total value of options in the portfolio

totalAmountShares.description: Total value of shares in the portfolio

totalAmountSp.description: Total value of structured notes in the portfolio

tools.name: invest_get_positions
tools.description: Get the list of positions for a brokerage account. Returns currency, blocked, securities, futures, and options positions.

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_broker_accounts.

tools.name: invest_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an active exchange order by its orderId. Returns the cancellation timestamp. This operation is irreversible — the order is removed from the exchange order book immediately upon acceptance.

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_broker_accounts.

tools.name: invest_create_order
tools.description: Create and submit a new order.

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_broker_accounts.

confirmMarginTrade.description: Consent to place an order that may result in an uncovered position. Default: false.

orderType.description: ORDER_TYPE_LIMIT — Limit. ORDER_TYPE_MARKET — Market. ORDER_TYPE_BESTPRICE — Best price.

price.description: Price per instrument unit as a decimal string. Required in practice for ORDER_TYPE_LIMIT; ignored for ORDER_TYPE_MARKET/ORDER_TYPE_BESTPRICE.

priceType.description: PRICE_TYPE_POINT — price in points. Valid ONLY for futures and bond instruments — using it for shares/etfs/currencies fails. PRICE_TYPE_CURRENCY — price in settlement currency. Use this for shares/etfs/currencies. Default: PRICE_TYPE_POINT for futures, PRICE_TYPE_CURRENCY for others — omit this field unless you specifically need points for a future or bond.

timeInForce.description: Order execution algorithm (limit orders only). TIME_IN_FORCE_DAY — keep until end of trading day (default). TIME_IN_FORCE_FILL_AND_KILL — execute what is possible immediately, cancel the rest. TIME_IN_FORCE_FILL_OR_KILL — execute in full immediately or cancel entirely.

totalOrderAmount.description: Total order amount including all commissions

tools.name: invest_get_max_lots
tools.description: Get available buy/sell lot limits for an instrument and account. If price is omitted, limits are calculated using current order book prices.

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_broker_accounts.

price.description: Instrument price as a decimal string. If omitted, current order book prices are used.

buyMaxLots.description: Maximum lots available for a limit buy order

buyMaxMarketLots.description: Maximum lots available for a market buy order at current prices

sellMaxLots.description: Maximum lots available for a sell order

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_broker_accounts.

price.description: Limit price per instrument unit as a decimal string.

extraBond.description: Additional data for bonds (present only for bond instruments)

nominalConversionRate.description: Nominal conversion rate for substitution bonds

extraFuture.description: Additional data for futures (present only for futures instruments)

initialMargin.description: Initial margin (guarantee deposit) for the futures contract

initialOrderAmount.description: Order amount without commissions, NKD, or initial margin

totalOrderAmount.description: Total order amount including all commissions and NKD

tools.name: invest_get_order_state
tools.description: Get the current state of a single order by its exchange identifier. Use responseView to limit returned fields.

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_broker_accounts.

priceType.description: PRICE_TYPE_POINT — price in points (futures and bonds only). PRICE_TYPE_CURRENCY — price in settlement currency.

responseView.description: BASE (orderId, status, type, direction, lots, amounts, date) always included. Add: ADVANCED=order prices/commissions/currency/execution stages. Use FULL for all.

executedOrderPrice.description: Executed order price (average price * lots executed)

stages.description: Individual trade executions within this order

totalOrderAmount.description: Total order amount including all commissions

tools.name: invest_get_orders

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_broker_accounts.

executionStatus.description: Filter by one or more execution statuses. Requires from to be set.

from.description: Start of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC). Applies only to orders created today. Required when executionStatus is specified. The from–to interval must not exceed 1 hour.

to.description: End of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC). Applies only to orders created today.

responseView.description: BASE (orderId, status, type, direction, lots, amounts, date) always included. Add: ADVANCED=order prices/commissions/currency/execution stages. Use FULL for all.

executedOrderPrice.description: Executed order price (average price * lots executed)

stages.description: Individual trade executions within this order

totalOrderAmount.description: Total order amount including all commissions

tools.name: invest_replace_order

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_broker_accounts.

confirmMarginTrade.description: Consent to place an order that may result in an uncovered position. Default: false.

idempotencyKey.description: New idempotency key in UUID format (max 36 chars). Provide the same UUID when retrying to avoid duplicate replacements.

price.description: New price per instrument unit as a decimal string.

priceType.description: PRICE_TYPE_POINT — price in points (futures and bonds only). PRICE_TYPE_CURRENCY — price in settlement currency. Default: PRICE_TYPE_POINT for futures, PRICE_TYPE_CURRENCY for others.

totalOrderAmount.description: Total order amount including all commissions

tools.name: invest_list_signals
tools.description: Get a list of trading signals filtered by instrument, direction, strategy, or date range. Use paging to iterate through large result sets. Returns signals with their target price, stop-loss, probability, and lifecycle status (active/closed).

active.description: Filter by signal status. SIGNAL_STATUS_ACTIVE — active signals (default). SIGNAL_STATUS_CLOSED — closed signals. SIGNAL_STATUS_ALL — all signals.

from.description: Start of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

strategyType.description: STRATEGY_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED — not specified. STRATEGY_TYPE_FUNDAMENTAL — fundamental analysis strategies. STRATEGY_TYPE_TECHNICAL — technical analysis strategies. STRATEGY_TYPE_UGC — Pulse community strategies.

to.description: End of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

tools.name: invest_list_strategies
tools.description: Get a list of trading strategies, optionally filtered by strategyId. Returns strategy type (fundamental, technical, or community/UGC), active and total signal counts, and yield statistics (overall and over the last year).

averageSignalYield.description: Average signal yield for the strategy.

averageSignalYieldYear.description: Average signal yield for the strategy over the last year.

strategyType.description: STRATEGY_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED — not specified. STRATEGY_TYPE_FUNDAMENTAL — fundamental analysis strategies. STRATEGY_TYPE_TECHNICAL — technical analysis strategies. STRATEGY_TYPE_UGC — Pulse community strategies.

totalSignals.description: Total number of signals in the strategy.

yieldYear.description: Strategy yield over the last year.

tools.name: invest_cancel_stoporder

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_accounts.

tools.name: invest_create_stoporder
tools.description: Create and submit a new stop-order (take-profit, stop-loss, or stop-limit). The stop order activates and places a child exchange order when the instrument price reaches stopPrice. When takeProfitType is TAKE_PROFIT_TYPE_TRAILING, trailingData is required.

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_accounts.

confirmMarginTrade.description: Consent to place an order that may result in an uncovered position. Default: false.

exchangeOrderType.description: Type of the child exchange order placed on activation. EXCHANGE_ORDER_TYPE_MARKET — Market order. EXCHANGE_ORDER_TYPE_LIMIT — Limit order.

expirationType.description: STOP_ORDER_EXPIRATION_TYPE_GOOD_TILL_CANCEL — Order is valid until cancelled. STOP_ORDER_EXPIRATION_TYPE_GOOD_TILL_DATE — Order is valid until the specified date.

expireDate.description: Stop order expiry date and time in UTC (ISO 8601). Required when expirationType is STOP_ORDER_EXPIRATION_TYPE_GOOD_TILL_DATE.

instantExecution.description: Activate the trailing stop immediately upon placement. Applicable only for trailing-stop orders.

price.description: Exchange order price per instrument unit. Used when stopOrderType is STOP_ORDER_TYPE_STOP_LIMIT.

priceType.description: PRICE_TYPE_POINT — price in points (futures and bonds only). PRICE_TYPE_CURRENCY — price in settlement currency. Default: PRICE_TYPE_POINT for futures, PRICE_TYPE_CURRENCY for others.

stopOrderType.description: STOP_ORDER_TYPE_TAKE_PROFIT — Take-profit order. STOP_ORDER_TYPE_STOP_LOSS — Stop-loss order. STOP_ORDER_TYPE_STOP_LIMIT — Stop-limit order.

stopPrice.description: Stop activation price per instrument unit. When reached, the exchange order is placed.

takeProfitType.description: Take-profit subtype. TAKE_PROFIT_TYPE_REGULAR — Regular take-profit (default). TAKE_PROFIT_TYPE_TRAILING — Trailing stop.

trailingData.description: Trailing stop parameters. Required when takeProfitType is TAKE_PROFIT_TYPE_TRAILING.

indent.description: Trailing indent (offset from the current price).

indentType.description: Indent value type. Required when indent is provided. TRAILING_VALUE_ABSOLUTE — absolute value in price units. TRAILING_VALUE_RELATIVE — relative value in percent of price.

spreadType.description: Spread value type. Required when spread is provided. TRAILING_VALUE_ABSOLUTE — absolute value in price units. TRAILING_VALUE_RELATIVE — relative value in percent of price.

tools.name: invest_get_stoporders
tools.description: Get the list of stop orders for a brokerage account. Use responseView to limit returned fields.

accountId.description: Brokerage account identifier. Must be a value returned by invest_list_accounts.

from.description: Start of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

responseView.description: BASE (stopOrderId, ticker, classCode, lotsRequested, direction, orderType, exchangeOrderType, stopPrice, price, status) always included. status.description: Filter by stop order status. STOP_ORDER_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED — active orders by default. STOP_ORDER_STATUS_ALL — all orders. STOP_ORDER_STATUS_ACTIVE — active orders. STOP_ORDER_STATUS_EXECUTED — executed orders. STOP_ORDER_STATUS_CANCELED — cancelled orders. STOP_ORDER_STATUS_EXPIRED — expired orders.

to.description: End of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

extr.description: Local price extremum tracked by the trailing stop.

indentType.description: TRAILING_VALUE_ABSOLUTE — absolute. TRAILING_VALUE_RELATIVE — relative percent of price.

price.description: Execution price at which the limit order will be placed on activation.

spreadType.description: TRAILING_VALUE_ABSOLUTE — absolute. TRAILING_VALUE_RELATIVE — relative percent of price.

status.description: TRAILING_STOP_ACTIVE — waiting for activation. TRAILING_STOP_ACTIVATED — activated.

activationDateTime.description: Date and time when the stop order was converted to an exchange order (UTC).

exchangeOrderId.description: Exchange order identifier assigned after stop order activation.

instantExecution.description: Whether the trailing stop activates immediately upon placement.

orderType.description: STOP_ORDER_TYPE_TAKE_PROFIT — Take-profit. STOP_ORDER_TYPE_STOP_LOSS — Stop-loss. STOP_ORDER_TYPE_STOP_LIMIT — Stop-limit.

price.description: Exchange order price per instrument unit.

stopPrice.description: Stop activation price per instrument unit.

tools.name: invest_get_candles
tools.description: Get historical candles for an instrument. Use instrumentId to specify the instrument, from/to to define the time range (ISO 8601 UTC), interval for the candle size, limit to cap the number of returned candles (counted back from to), and candleSourceType to filter by data source. Always read priceCurrency in the response to determine the actual currency (it may be "pt" for exchange points).

candleSourceType.description: Candle source filter. UNSPECIFIED — all candles. EXCHANGE — exchange candles only. INCLUDE_WEEKEND — all candles including weekend trading. Cannot be combined with limit.

from.description: Start of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

interval.description: Candle interval. 5_SEC — max limit 2500. 10_SEC — max limit 1250. 30_SEC — max limit 2500. 1_MIN — max limit 2400. 2_MIN — max limit 1200. 3_MIN — max limit 750. 5_MIN — max limit 2400. 10_MIN — max limit 1200. 15_MIN — max limit 2400. 30_MIN — max limit 1200. HOUR — max limit 2400. 2_HOUR — max limit 2400. 4_HOUR — max limit 700. DAY — max limit 2400. WEEK — max limit 300. MONTH — max limit 120.

limit.description: Maximum number of candles to return, counted back from to. Cannot be combined with candleSourceType.

to.description: End of the requested period (ISO 8601 UTC).

candleSource.description: Candle data source. UNSPECIFIED — unspecified. EXCHANGE — exchange candles. DEALER_WEEKEND — dealer weekend candles.

isComplete.description: True if the candle interval is fully closed

priceCurrency.description: Currency of the price values, e.g. rub, usd. Can also be pt for futures and bonds, meaning the prices are exchange points.

tools.name: invest_list_accounts
tools.description: List all accounts (brokerage and bank) belonging to the authenticated user in one call. Bank accounts additionally carry a money field with currency balances.  Filter by status ACCOUNT_STATUS_OPEN to retrieve only active brokerage accounts —  this filter does not affect bank accounts, which are always included.

status.description: Filter brokerage accounts by lifecycle status. Does not affect bank accounts. Omit to return all accounts.

accounts.description: Unified list of brokerage and bank accounts

accessLevel.description: Access level to the account (brokerage accounts only)

closedDate.description: Closing date in ISO 8601 UTC (brokerage accounts only)

tools.name: invest_close_sandbox_account
tools.description: Close a sandbox (demo) brokerage account by its accountId. The account and all its positions are permanently deleted. This operation is irreversible. Only available on the sandbox endpoint.

tools.name: invest_deposit_sandbox_account
tools.description: Deposit virtual funds into a sandbox brokerage account. Returns the resulting account balance. Only available on the sandbox endpoint — does not involve real money.

tools.name: invest_open_sandbox_account
tools.description: Open a new sandbox (demo) brokerage account for testing purposes. Returns the newly created accountId. Only available on the sandbox endpoint — does not involve real money.
